I can do that — but canceling a calendar event is a destructive, visible change, so I need a few confirmations first.

Please confirm these details:
1. Exact event to cancel (title): "Design review" — is that correct?  
   - If you have multiple events with that name, give an example date/time of one instance so I pick the right one.
2. Which scope do you want?  
   - Cancel the entire recurring series (every Tuesday), or cancel only future occurrences, or cancel a single occurrence (which date)?
3. Exact time/time zone: you said "Tuesday afternoon" — what start time (e.g., 3:00 PM) and time zone should I use to identify the event?
4. Notify attendees? If yes, do you want me to send the default cancellation or include a custom message (please provide text if you want a custom message)?
5. Which calendar (if you have more than one) should I modify?

If you want a suggested cancellation message, here’s a short draft you can approve or edit:
"Hi all — The recurring Design review meeting on Tuesdays is cancelled effective immediately. I’ll follow up with next steps and a new cadence if/when needed. Thanks."

Reply with your choices and I’ll proceed.
